QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] For Her Smile 2
QuestInfo.0: One of the 'shrooms at the banquet looks very out of place. Ask him why he's so nervous.
QuestInfo.1: Mikhail is infatuated with Princess Violetta. He claims no one can top his loyalty to her. He just doesn't feel like he has the looks to impress her. Some new armor would help.
QuestInfo.2: Mikhail is very in love with Princess Violetta. He got a sharp new suit of armor... but no one noticed him! Poor little guy!

0.0: Look at how the princess shimmers with raw beauty! If only I could be so disgustingly phosphorescent. My name is #bMikhail#k, the most loyal of all mushrooms.
0.1: I cannot even imagine presenting myself like this... Can you help me find my very own inner light, please?

yes.0: I'm confident I can protect the princess from any danger, but I need armor to display my bravery. Please get me #r20 #t4034105##k items.

no.0: Hey, I know I'm just a store worker, but I have feelings too!

1.0: I was beginning to worry you forgot about my request. Why not engage in some merry coordination?

default.0: Please get me #r20 #t4034105##k items. Why not help each other on this solitary venture?
